series.name: Primairy light-commercial error messages bulletin (GB distributor)
series.notes: HITACHI Primairy Error Messages fault-code bulletin (GB), PDF hosted by Logicool AC (UK Hitachi distributor); corroborated by yorknow.com UMC install guide §7. Distributor bulletin. Medium-high. E-prefix + numeric schemes; LED tens/units two-digit reading.

meaning.en: The outdoor ambient temperature sensor circuit reads open, short or unplugged.
meaning.ur: Outdoor ambient temperature sensor ki circuit open, short ya disconnect parhi ja rahi hai

causes.en: The sensor itself is defective or its resistance has drifted out of range.
causes.ur: Sensor khud kharab hai ya us ki resistance range se bahar chali gayi hai

causes.en: Sensor connector is loose, the lead is broken or the input circuit on the control board has failed.
causes.ur: Sensor ka connector dheela, lead tooti hui hai ya control board ka input circuit kharab ho gaya

solutions.en: Measure sensor resistance against the temperature table and re-seat or replace the sensor.
solutions.ur: Temperature table ke mutabiq sensor ki resistance napen aur sensor dobara lagayein ya badal dein

solutions.en: If the wiring checks out, replace the outdoor control board.
solutions.ur: Wiring theek nikle to outdoor control board badal dein

notes.en: Shown as 'E' plus the number on the outdoor 7-segment display and on the wired controller. Primairy H-LINK adapter mapping calls the same fault Primairy code 1 (airCloud Pro 22).
notes.ur: Yeh outdoor 7-segment display aur wired controller par 'E' plus number ke tor par nazar aata hai. Primairy H-LINK adapter mapping isi fault ko Primairy code 1 (airCloud Pro 22) kehti hai.

meaning.en: The outdoor coil (heat exchanger) temperature sensor circuit is open, short or disconnected.
meaning.ur: Outdoor coil (heat exchanger) temperature sensor ki circuit open, short ya disconnect hai

causes.en: Defective sensor or damaged sensor lead.
causes.ur: Sensor kharab hai ya us ki lead tooti hui hai

causes.en: Connector not seated or a fault on the control board input.
causes.ur: Connector baitha hua nahi ya control board ke input mein kharabi hai

solutions.en: Reconnect the sensor and verify the reading with a resistance measurement.
solutions.ur: Sensor dobara reconnect karein aur resistance nap kar reading ki tasdeiq karein

solutions.en: Replace the sensor, or the control board if the wiring is sound.
solutions.ur: Sensor badal dein, ya agar wiring salamat ho to control board badal dein

notes.en: Corroborated by the Primairy H-LINK adapter mapping (Primairy code 2, outdoor coil temperature sensor fault).
notes.ur: Primairy H-LINK adapter mapping ise confirm karti hai (Primairy code 2, outdoor coil temperature sensor fault).

meaning.en: The unit stopped because the compressor drew excessive current.
meaning.ur: Compressor ne bohat zyada current liya, is liye unit band ho gayi

causes.en: Overload in heating or cooling mode, for example a blocked outdoor coil or high ambient.
causes.ur: Heating ya cooling mode mein overload — maslan outdoor coil band hua ho ya ambient temperature zyada ho

causes.en: Compressor defective, under-voltage supply or a failing control board.
causes.ur: Compressor kharab, supply ka under-voltage ya control board kharab hota hua

solutions.en: Check the refrigeration circuit, running current and supply voltage against nameplate values.
solutions.ur: Refrigeration circuit, running current aur supply voltage ko nameplate values se compare kar ke check karein

solutions.en: Replace the compressor or control board only after the electrical checks pass.
solutions.ur: Compressor ya control board tabhi badlein jab electrical checks pass ho jayen

notes.en: Corroborated by the Primairy H-LINK adapter mapping (unit over-current turn off fault, Primairy code 3).
notes.ur: Primairy H-LINK adapter mapping ise confirm karti hai (unit over-current turn off fault, Primairy code 3).

meaning.en: The stored configuration data on the control board could not be read or is invalid.
meaning.ur: Control board par stored configuration data parh nahi ja sakta ya invalid hai

causes.en: EEPROM chip failure after a power event or board ageing.
causes.ur: Power ke waqt ya board ke purane hone se EEPROM chip kharab ho gaya

causes.en: Corrupt or incomplete data written during service or parameter setting.
causes.ur: Service ya parameter setting ke doran data corrupt ya adhoora likha gaya

solutions.en: Reload or restore the unit parameters, then clear the alarm and restart.
solutions.ur: Unit ke parameters reload karein, phir alarm clear kar ke restart karein

solutions.en: If the fault returns, replace the control board.
solutions.ur: Kharabi wapas aaye to control board badal dein

notes.en: Corroborated by the Primairy H-LINK adapter mapping (EEPROM Data error, Primairy code 4).
notes.ur: Primairy H-LINK adapter mapping ise confirm karti hai (EEPROM Data error, Primairy code 4).

meaning.en: Freeze protection tripped while cooling, or overheat protection tripped while heating.
meaning.ur: Cooling ke doran freeze protection, ya heating ke doran overheat protection faal hui

causes.en: Airflow through the indoor unit is too low, for example a dirty filter or slow fan.
causes.ur: Indoor unit se hawa bahut kam ja rahi hai, masla gande filter ya slow fan mein hai

causes.en: Room conditions are out of range, external static pressure is too high or the fan speed setting is too low.
causes.ur: Room ki conditions range se bahar hain, external static pressure zyada hai ya fan speed setting kam hai

solutions.en: Clean the air filter, check the whole fan path and air distribution and restore normal airflow.
solutions.ur: Air filter saaf karein, poori fan path aur hawa ke distribution ko check karke normal airflow bahal karein

solutions.en: Verify room temperature and fan setting, then reset the unit and restart.
solutions.ur: Room temperature aur fan setting check karein, phir unit ko dobara chala dein

notes.en: Corroborated by the Primairy H-LINK adapter mapping (cooling freezing protection or heating overload, Primairy code 5).
notes.ur: Primairy H-LINK adapter mapping ise confirm karti hai (cooling freezing protection or heating overload, Primairy code 5).

meaning.en: The indoor and outdoor units stopped exchanging signals correctly.
meaning.ur: Indoor aur outdoor units sahi tarah signal ka exchange nahi kar rahe

causes.en: Interconnecting cable broken, loose or incorrectly wired, or a blown fuse.
causes.ur: Interconnecting cable tooti, dheeli ya ghalat tareeke se lagi ho, ya fuse ura ho gaya ho

causes.en: No control voltage on one side or a failed indoor/outdoor circuit board.
causes.ur: Aik taraf control voltage nahi hai ya dono units ki circuit board kharab hai

solutions.en: Rewire per the installation diagram, check all fuses and supply voltage.
solutions.ur: Installation diagram ke mutabiq wiring dobara karein, tamam fuses aur supply voltage check karein

solutions.en: Substitute the cable or board one at a time to isolate the fault.
solutions.ur: Kharabi alag karne ke liye cable ya board aik aik kar ke badal kar test karein

notes.en: Corroborated by the Primairy H-LINK adapter mapping (communication fault between indoor and outdoor unit, Primairy code 7).
notes.ur: Ye ise Primairy H-LINK adapter mapping confirm karti hai (dono units ke darmiyan communication fault, Primairy code 7).

meaning.en: A phase is missing from the outdoor supply or the phases are in the wrong sequence.
meaning.ur: Outdoor supply mein koi phase ghaayab hai ya phases ghalat tar se hain

causes.en: One supply phase is absent or the phase sequence is reversed.
causes.ur: Supply ka aik phase ghaayab hai ya phase ki tar palat hui hai

causes.en: Fault on the outdoor control board phase detection circuit.
causes.ur: Outdoor control board ki phase detection circuit mein kharabi

solutions.en: Measure phase-to-phase and phase-to-neutral voltages and correct the incoming sequence.
solutions.ur: Phase to phase aur phase to neutral voltages napen aur aane wali phase ki tar theek karein

solutions.en: If the supply is correct, replace the outdoor circuit board as a test.
solutions.ur: Supply theek ho to azmaya kar ke outdoor circuit board badal dein

notes.en: Mains-phase fault, same hazard class as alarm 05 in the other series. Corroborated by the H-LINK mapping (voltage absent phase, Primairy 12).
notes.ur: Mains phase ka fault hai, doosri series ke alarm 05 jaisa hi khatra hai. H-LINK mapping ise confirm karti hai (voltage absent phase, Primairy 12).

title.ur: Compressor ki overheat protection trip hui

meaning.en: The compressor overheat protective device opened.
meaning.ur: Compressor ki overheat protective device khul gayi

causes.en: Protective device not connected, or refrigerant charge too low.
causes.ur: Protective device connected nahi, ya refrigerant charge bohat kam hai

causes.en: Expansion valve not opening, or pipework kinked or too long without extra charge.
causes.ur: Expansion valve khul nahi raha, ya piping mein muda hua hissa hai ya piping bohat lamba hai aur extra charge nahi daala gaya

solutions.en: Connect the protective device, check and top up the refrigerant charge.
solutions.ur: Protective device connect karein, refrigerant charge check kar ke poori karein

solutions.en: Check the expansion valve operation and replace it if it does not open.
solutions.ur: Expansion valve ka kaam check karein aur agar wo na khule to badal dein

notes.en: Corroborated by the H-LINK mapping (compressor overheat protector device, Primairy 13).
notes.ur: H-LINK mapping ise confirm karti hai (compressor overheat protector device, Primairy 13).

meaning.en: The high pressure safety switch opened because system pressure rose too high.
meaning.ur: System ka pressure bohat zyada ho jane se high pressure safety switch khul gaya

causes.en: High pressure switch defective or not connected.
causes.ur: High pressure switch kharab hai ya connect nahi

causes.en: Dirty indoor or outdoor heat exchanger, low airflow, fan problem or overcharge.
causes.ur: Kamre wale ya bahar wale heat exchanger ganda, airflow kam, fan kharab ya zyada charge

solutions.en: Clean both heat exchangers, check fan operation and airflow and confirm the charge.
solutions.ur: Dono heat exchangers saaf karein, fan aur airflow ka kaam check kar ke charge ki tasdeiq karein

solutions.en: Test the pressure switch and circuit board and replace any faulty part.
solutions.ur: Pressure switch aur circuit board test karein aur kharab part badal dein.

notes.en: Corroborated by the H-LINK mapping (high pressure switch operate, Primairy 14).
notes.ur: H-LINK mapping ise confirm karti hai (high pressure switch operate, Primairy 14).

meaning.en: The low pressure safety switch opened, indicating loss of suction pressure.
meaning.ur: Suction pressure kam ho jane se low pressure safety switch khul gaya

causes.en: Low pressure switch defective or not connected.
causes.ur: Low pressure switch kharab hai ya connect nahi

causes.en: Dirty heat exchanger, low airflow, faulty expansion valve or wrong refrigerant charge.
causes.ur: Heat exchanger ganda ho, airflow kam ho, expansion valve kharab ho ya refrigerant charge ghalat ho

solutions.en: Check the heat exchanger cleanliness, fan setting and expansion valve operation.
solutions.ur: Heat exchanger ki safai, fan setting aur expansion valve ka kaam check karein

solutions.en: Verify refrigerant charge, correct any leak and replace the switch if it reads closed.
solutions.ur: Refrigerant charge check karein, leak theek karein aur switch band parhe to badal dein

notes.en: Corroborated by the H-LINK mapping (low pressure switch protection, Primairy 15).
notes.ur: H-LINK mapping ise confirm karti hai (low pressure switch protection, Primairy 15).

meaning.en: The unit went into overload protection while cooling.
meaning.ur: Unit cooling ke doran overload protection mein chala gaya

causes.en: Dirty outdoor heat exchanger or excessively high ambient temperature.
causes.ur: Outdoor heat exchanger ganda ho ya ambient temperature bohat zyada ho

causes.en: Outdoor fan defective or the system is overfilled with refrigerant.
causes.ur: Outdoor fan kharab hai ya system mein refrigerant zyada bhar gaya hai

solutions.en: Clean the condenser, improve the installation location and check the fan.
solutions.ur: Condenser saaf karein, installation ki jagah behtar karein aur fan check karein

solutions.en: Correct the refrigerant charge to the nameplate amount.
solutions.ur: Refrigerant charge ko nameplate ki miqdar ke mutabiq theek karein

notes.en: Corroborated by the H-LINK mapping (overload protection in cooling mode, Primairy 16).
notes.ur: H-LINK mapping ise confirm karti hai (overload protection in cooling mode, Primairy 16).

title.ur: Compressor head temperature sensor ki kharabi

meaning.en: The sensor measuring temperature at the compressor head is open, short or unplugged.
meaning.ur: Compressor ke head par temperature napne wala sensor open, short ya disconnect hai

causes.en: Defective sensor or damaged lead.
causes.ur: Sensor kharab hai ya us ki lead tooti hui hai

causes.en: Sensor connector loose or control board input faulty.
causes.ur: Sensor ka connector dheela hai ya control board ka input kharab hai

solutions.en: Reconnect or replace the sensor after checking its resistance.
solutions.ur: Resistance check karne ke baad sensor dobara lagayein ya badal dein

solutions.en: Replace the control board if the sensor circuit tests good.
solutions.ur: Sensor circuit theek nikle to control board badal dein

notes.en: H-LINK mapping names code 17 as discharge temperature sensor fault, so treat head and discharge sensors as this channel.
notes.ur: H-LINK mapping mein code 17 ko discharge temperature sensor fault kaha gaya hai, is liye head aur discharge sensor ko isi channel ke roop mein samajhein.

title.ur: Inverter board ki supply voltage kharabi

meaning.en: AC or DC supply voltages to the inverter control board are far outside the normal range.
meaning.ur: Inverter control board ko jane wale AC ya DC voltages normal range se kaafi door hain

causes.en: Mains voltage sag or swell, or an undersized supply cable.
causes.ur: Mains voltage giray ya uthe, ya supply cable ka size chhota ho

causes.en: Rectifier or smoothing components on the inverter board failing.
causes.ur: Inverter board ke rectifier ya smoothing parts kharab ho rahe hain

solutions.en: Check the supply voltage and cable cross-section and correct the power feed.
solutions.ur: Supply voltage aur cable ka cross-section check kar ke power feed theek karein

solutions.en: Confirm the DC bus is stable and replace the board if it is not.
solutions.ur: DC bus ke stable hone ki tasdeiq karein, na ho to board badal dein

notes.en: Corroborated by the H-LINK mapping (AC voltage is abnormal, Primairy 18).
notes.ur: H-LINK mapping ise confirm karti hai (AC voltage is abnormal, Primairy 18).

title.ur: Suction line temperature sensor ki kharabi

meaning.en: The suction line temperature sensor circuit is open, short or disconnected.
meaning.ur: Suction line temperature sensor ki circuit open, short ya disconnect hai

causes.en: Defective sensor or damaged sensor lead.
causes.ur: Sensor kharab hai ya us ki lead tooti hui hai

causes.en: Loose connector or a fault on the board input.
causes.ur: Connector dheela hai ya board ke input mein kharabi hai

solutions.en: Reconnect or replace the sensor after a resistance check.
solutions.ur: Resistance check ke baad sensor dobara lagayein ya badal dein

solutions.en: Replace the control board if the wiring tests good.
solutions.ur: Wiring theek nikle to control board badal dein

notes.en: Corroborated by the H-LINK mapping (suction temperature sensor fault, Primairy 19).
notes.ur: H-LINK mapping ise confirm karti hai (suction temperature sensor fault, Primairy 19).

meaning.en: The defrost (outdoor coil) sensor circuit is open, short or disconnected.
meaning.ur: Defrost (outdoor coil) sensor ki circuit open, short ya disconnect hai

causes.en: Defective sensor or damaged lead.
causes.ur: Sensor kharab hai ya lead tooti hui hai

causes.en: Loose connector or control board input failure.
causes.ur: Connector dheela hai ya control board ka input kharab ho gaya

solutions.en: Reconnect or replace the sensor after a resistance check.
solutions.ur: Resistance check ke baad sensor dobara lagayein ya badal dein

solutions.en: Replace the control board if the sensor circuit tests good.
solutions.ur: Sensor circuit theek nikle to control board badal dein

notes.en: The description cell in the PDF is corrupted in extraction and printed the remedy text instead of the name; the Primairy H-LINK mapping confirms code 22 as the defrosting sensor fault.
notes.ur: PDF se extraction ke waqt description wala cell kharab ho gaya aur us ki jagah remedy text print ho gaya; Primairy H-LINK mapping code 22 ko defrosting sensor fault confirm karti hai.

meaning.en: The intelligent power module of the inverter reported a fault.
meaning.ur: Inverter ka intelligent power module ne kharabi report ki

causes.en: IPM or its power supply defective.
causes.ur: IPM ya us ki power supply kharab hai

causes.en: Compressor faulty, drawing high current.
causes.ur: Compressor kharab hai aur zyada current le raha hai

solutions.en: Check the power supply and compressor insulation and current draw.
solutions.ur: Power supply aur compressor ki insulation aur current check karein

solutions.en: Replace the IPM or the compressor depending on the test result.
solutions.ur: Test ke nataije ke mutabiq IPM ya compressor badal dein

notes.en: Corroborated by the H-LINK mapping (IPM fault, Primairy 45).
notes.ur: H-LINK mapping ise confirm karti hai (IPM fault, Primairy 45).

meaning.en: The link between the control board and the IPM is broken or the modules have failed.
meaning.ur: Control board aur IPM ka link toota hua hai ya module kharab hain

causes.en: Connecting cable between control board and IPM broken or not connected.
causes.ur: Control board aur IPM ke darmiyan cable tooti ya connect nahi

causes.en: IPM or control board defective.
causes.ur: IPM ya control board kharab hai

solutions.en: Reconnect or replace the interconnect cable.
solutions.ur: Interconnect cable dobara lagayein ya badal dein

solutions.en: Replace the IPM or the control board after substitution testing.
solutions.ur: Substitution test karke IPM ya control board badal dein

notes.en: Corroborated by the H-LINK mapping (IPM and control board communication fault, Primairy 46).
notes.ur: H-LINK mapping ise confirm karti hai (IPM and control board communication fault, Primairy 46).

meaning.en: Hot gas temperature at the compressor head or outlet exceeded the allowed limit.
meaning.ur: Compressor head ya outlet par garm gas ki temperature ajazat se zyada ho gayi

causes.en: Refrigerant charge too low or the additional pipework charge was not added.
causes.ur: Refrigerant charge bohat kam hai ya extra piping ka charge nahi daala gaya

causes.en: Expansion valve not opening or shut-off valves left closed.
causes.ur: Expansion valve khul nahi raha, ya shut-off valves band chhor diye gaye hain

solutions.en: Leak-test the system, repair any leak and weigh in the correct charge.
solutions.ur: System ka leak test karein, leak theek karein aur sahi charge tol lein

solutions.en: Check expansion valve operation and fully open the service valves.
solutions.ur: Expansion valve ka kaam check karein aur service valve ko poori tarah khol lein

notes.en: Corroborated by the H-LINK mapping (discharge temperature too high fault, Primairy 47).
notes.ur: H-LINK mapping ise confirm karti hai (discharge temperature too high fault, Primairy 47).

title.en: Outdoor DC fan motor fault (upper fan)
title.ur: Outdoor DC fan motor kharab (upper fan)

meaning.en: The upper outdoor DC fan motor is blocked, disconnected or failed.
meaning.ur: Outdoor ka upar wala DC fan motor ruka hua, disconnect ya kharab hai

causes.en: Fan blocked or blades damaged, or extreme wind loading.
causes.ur: Fan ruka hua ho, ya blades toot gaye hon, ya bohat tez hawa ka bojh ho

causes.en: Motor not connected, winding open or driver fault.
causes.ur: Motor connect nahi, winding khuli ya driver kharab hai

solutions.en: Check motor and wiring, free the fan and replace the motor if seized.
solutions.ur: Motor aur wiring check karein, fan ko azaad karein aur motor jam ho to badal dein

solutions.en: Protect the unit from direct wind and verify the supply to the driver.
solutions.ur: Unit ko seedhi hawa se bachayein aur driver ki supply check karein

notes.en: Applies to stacked outdoor units. Corroborated by the H-LINK mapping (outdoor DC fan motor fault, upper fan motor, Primairy 48).
notes.ur: Yeh stacked outdoor units par lagta hai. H-LINK mapping ise confirm karti hai (outdoor DC fan motor fault, upper fan motor, Primairy 48).

title.en: Outdoor DC fan motor fault (lower fan)
title.ur: Outdoor DC fan motor kharab (lower fan)

meaning.en: The lower outdoor DC fan motor is blocked, disconnected or failed.
meaning.ur: Outdoor ka neeche wala DC fan motor ruka hua, disconnect ya kharab hai

causes.en: Fan blocked or blades damaged, or extreme wind loading.
causes.ur: Fan ruka hua ho, ya blades toot gaye hon, ya bohat tez hawa ka bojh ho

causes.en: Motor not connected, winding open or driver fault.
causes.ur: Motor connect nahi, winding khuli ya driver kharab hai

solutions.en: Check motor and wiring, free the fan and replace the motor if seized.
solutions.ur: Motor aur wiring check karein, fan ko azaad karein aur motor jam ho to badal dein

solutions.en: Protect the unit from direct wind and verify the supply to the driver.
solutions.ur: Unit ko seedhi hawa se bachayein aur driver ki supply check karein

notes.en: Corroborated by the H-LINK mapping (outdoor DC fan motor fault, down fan motor, Primairy 49).
notes.ur: H-LINK mapping ise confirm karti hai (outdoor DC fan motor fault, down fan motor, Primairy 49).

title.ur: IPM ke zyada garm hone se shutdown

meaning.en: The unit shut down because the inverter power module became too hot.
meaning.ur: Inverter power module zyada garm ho jane ki wajah se unit band ho gaya

causes.en: Outdoor temperature too low for the cooling of the fins, or fan speed too low.
causes.ur: Fins ko thanda karne ke liye outdoor temperature sahi nahi ya fan speed bahut kam hai

causes.en: Mains voltage low or restricted airflow across the condenser.
causes.ur: Mains voltage kam hai ya condenser par hawa ka rasta band hai

solutions.en: Check the fan, the installation clearances and the mains supply.
solutions.ur: Fan, installation ki khali jagah aur mains supply check karein

solutions.en: Clean the heat exchanger and restore full airflow before restarting.
solutions.ur: Dobara chalane se pehle heat exchanger saaf karein aur poori airflow bahal karein

notes.en: Corroborated by the H-LINK mapping (unit turn off due to IPM board over heating fault, Primairy 91).
notes.ur: H-LINK mapping ise confirm karti hai (unit turn off due to IPM board over heating fault, Primairy 91).

meaning.en: The system detected a lack of refrigerant.
meaning.ur: System ne refrigerant ki kami detect kar li

causes.en: Leak in the refrigerant circuit or faulty service valves.
causes.ur: Refrigerant circuit mein leak hai ya service valves kharab hain

causes.en: Valves not fully opened after installation.
causes.ur: Installation ke baad valves poori tarah khule nahi hue

solutions.en: Find and repair the leak, then evacuate and weigh in the correct charge.
solutions.ur: Leak dhoond kar theek karein, phir vacuum le kar sahi charge tol lein

solutions.en: Confirm all service valves are fully open and re-check performance.
solutions.ur: Tamam service valve poori tarah khule hain, is ki tasdeiq karein aur performance dobara check karein

notes.en: Corroborated by the H-LINK mapping (the refrigerant of the unit is not enough fault, Primairy 96). The bulletin cross-refers to error 47.
notes.ur: H-LINK mapping ise confirm karti hai (the refrigerant of the unit is not enough fault, Primairy 96). Bulletin error 47 ki taraf bhi refer karti hai.

meaning.en: The reversing valve is stuck or its coil or board circuit has failed, so the unit cools when it should heat.
meaning.ur: Reversing valve atka hua hai ya us ka coil ya board circuit kharab hai, is liye unit garmi ke bajaye cooling kar raha hai

causes.en: Four-way valve, its coil or the control board is defective.
causes.ur: Four-way valve, us ka coil ya control board kharab hai

causes.en: Valve spool stuck from contamination or sluggish supply voltage.
causes.ur: Valve ka spool ala ho jane ya supply voltage kam hone ki wajah se atak gaya hai

solutions.en: Actuate the reversing valve and check coil voltage and resistance.
solutions.ur: Reversing valve ko operate kar ke us ke coil ki voltage aur resistance check karein

solutions.en: Replace the valve coil, the valve or the board depending on findings.
solutions.ur: Natije ke mutabiq valve ka coil, valve ya board badal dein

notes.en: Corroborated by the H-LINK mapping (4-way valve commutation failure fault, Primairy 97).
notes.ur: H-LINK mapping ise confirm karti hai (4-way valve commutation failure fault, Primairy 97).

title.ur: Compressor ki current limit ho gayi

meaning.en: Compressor current is too high and the frequency or current cannot be raised any further.
meaning.ur: Compressor ka current zyada hai aur frequency ya current aur barhaya nahi ja sakta

causes.en: Compressor drawing excessive current or a weak supply.
causes.ur: Compressor zyada current le raha hai ya supply kamzor hai

causes.en: Inverter or IPM limiting output because of an emerging fault.
causes.ur: Kisi aane wale fault ki wajah se inverter ya IPM output limit kar raha hai

solutions.en: Check compressor winding, running current and supply voltage.
solutions.ur: Compressor ki coil, current aur supply voltage check karein

solutions.en: Service the inverter stage and replace the compressor if it is seized.
solutions.ur: Inverter stage ki repair karein aur agar compressor jam ho gaya ho to badal dein

notes.en: Only this bulletin publishes E101; the Primairy H-LINK mapping table stops at 97, so the code is single-sourced.
notes.ur: Sirf yehi bulletin E101 publish karta hai; Primairy H-LINK mapping table 97 par ruk jati hai, is liye yeh code single-source hai.

meaning.en: The condensate float or drain monitoring device tripped the unit.
meaning.ur: Condensate float ya drain monitoring device ne unit band kar diya

causes.en: Condensate float triggered, not connected or defective.
causes.ur: Condensate float trigger hua, connect nahi ya kharab hai

causes.en: Defrost water pump faulty or the drain is blocked.
causes.ur: Defrost water pump kharab hai ya drain band hai

solutions.en: Check the condensate level, clear the drain and test the pump.
solutions.ur: Condensate level dekh lein, drain saaf kariye aur pump test kar lein

solutions.en: Replace the float switch, pump, wiring or board as found.
solutions.ur: Jaisa mila waise float switch, pump, wiring ya board badal dein

notes.en: Corroborated by the H-LINK mapping (drainage protection, Primairy 51).
notes.ur: H-LINK mapping ise confirm karti hai (drainage protection, Primairy 51).

codes.blinkPattern: Two-digit code read from LEDs, 2 s pauses: red operating LED = tens digit (5), green defrost LED = units digit (1)

meaning.en: Indoor units on the system have selected different operating modes.
meaning.ur: System ke indoor units ne alag alag operating modes chune rakhe hain

causes.en: One indoor unit is in heating while another is in cooling.
causes.ur: Aik indoor unit garmi mein hai jab doosra cooling mein hai

causes.en: Mode settings were changed independently after a power event.
causes.ur: Power ke waqt ke baad mode settings alag alag badal di gayi hain

solutions.en: Set the same operating mode on all indoor units of the circuit.
solutions.ur: Circuit ke tamam indoor units par aik hi operating mode set karein

solutions.en: Reset the controllers and confirm the system runs without the alarm.
solutions.ur: Controllers reset karein aur tasdeeq karein ke system alarm ke baghair chalta hai

notes.en: Single-source row, not present in the Primairy H-LINK mapping extract.
notes.ur: Sirf ek hi source se aaya row hai, Primairy H-LINK mapping extract mein maujood nahi.

codes.blinkPattern: Two-digit code read from LEDs, 2 s pauses: red operating LED = 5 blinks, green defrost LED = 5 blinks

meaning.en: Signal exchange between indoor and outdoor boards has failed.
meaning.ur: Dono unit boards ke darmiyan signal exchange nakam ho gaya

causes.en: Interconnecting cable wired incorrectly or damaged.
causes.ur: Interconnecting cable ki wiring galat hai ya cable kharab hai

causes.en: Circuit board defective indoors or outdoors.
causes.ur: Kamre wali ya beruni unit ki circuit board kharab hai

solutions.en: Check the connection line for open or short circuits and repair it.
solutions.ur: Connection line ko open ya short ke liye check kar ke theek karein

solutions.en: Replace the indoor or outdoor board if the cable tests good.
solutions.ur: Cable theek nikle to kamre wali ya beruni board badal dein

notes.en: Corroborated by the H-LINK mapping (communication between indoor and outdoor unit fault, Primairy 64).
notes.ur: Ye ise H-LINK mapping confirm karti hai (dono units ke darmiyan communication fault, Primairy 64).

codes.blinkPattern: Two-digit code read from LEDs, 2 s pauses: red operating LED = 6 blinks, green defrost LED = 4 blinks

meaning.en: The indoor control board reported an internal fault.
meaning.ur: Indoor control board ne internal fault report kiya

causes.en: Board component failure or loose motor wiring.
causes.ur: Board ka koi hissa kharab hai ya motor ki wiring dheeli hai

causes.en: Motor defective feeding an error back to the board.
causes.ur: Motor kharab hai jo board ko ghalat feedback de raha hai

solutions.en: Inspect and re-seat the motor wiring, then run the board self-check.
solutions.ur: Motor ki wiring check kar ke mazboot karein, phir board ka self check chalaayein

solutions.en: Replace the indoor control board if the fault persists.
solutions.ur: Kharabi barqar rahe to indoor control board badal dein

notes.en: Conflict: the bulletin names 71 as an indoor circuit board error, while the Primairy H-LINK adapter debug table names 71 the zero-crossing fault. Both readings point at the indoor control board, so verify on the unit before quoting.
notes.ur: Conflict: bulletin 71 ko indoor circuit board error kehta hai, jabke Primairy H-LINK adapter debug table isi 71 ko zero-crossing fault kehti hai. Dono reading indoor control board ki taraf ishara karti hain, is liye bolne se pehle unit par verify karein.

codes.blinkPattern: Two-digit code read from LEDs, 2 s pauses: red operating LED = 7 blinks, green defrost LED = 1 blink

meaning.en: The indoor fan motor is jammed, disconnected or drawing abnormal current.
meaning.ur: Indoor fan motor jam hai, disconnect hai ya abnormal current le raha hai

causes.en: Fan motor wiring loose or motor defective.
causes.ur: Fan motor ki wiring dheeli hai ya motor kharab hai

causes.en: Circuit board defective.
causes.ur: Circuit board kharab hai

solutions.en: Check fan motor connections and replace the motor if it does not run freely.
solutions.ur: Fan motor ke connections check karein aur motor azaadi se na chale to badal dein

solutions.en: Replace the circuit board if the motor tests good.
solutions.ur: Motor theek nikle to circuit board badal dein

notes.en: Corroborated by the H-LINK mapping (indoor fan motor fault, Primairy 72) and by the HCAA adapter debug table (72 IDU fan motor fault).
notes.ur: H-LINK mapping (indoor fan motor fault, Primairy 72) aur HCAA adapter debug table (72 IDU fan motor fault) ise confirm karte hain.

codes.blinkPattern: Two-digit code read from LEDs, 2 s pauses: red operating LED = 7 blinks, green defrost LED = 2 blinks

meaning.en: Data error on the indoor control board memory.
meaning.ur: Indoor control board ki memory mein data kharabi hai

causes.en: EEPROM failure or invalid stored data.
causes.ur: EEPROM kharab hai ya stored data invalid hai

causes.en: Board replaced without reprogramming parameters.
causes.ur: Board tabbadla gaya magar parameters wapas program nahi kiye gaye

solutions.en: Reload the unit parameters and clear the alarm.
solutions.ur: Unit ke parameters dobara load karein aur alarm clear karein

solutions.en: Replace the indoor control board if the data will not hold.
solutions.ur: Data theek na rahe to indoor control board badal dein

notes.en: Corroborated by the H-LINK mapping (indoor EEPROM Data 1 fault, Primairy 73).
notes.ur: H-LINK mapping ise confirm karti hai (indoor EEPROM Data 1 fault, Primairy 73).

codes.blinkPattern: Two-digit code read from LEDs, 2 s pauses: red operating LED = 7 blinks, green defrost LED = 3 blinks

meaning.en: Second memory block on the indoor control board reported a data error.
meaning.ur: Indoor control board ke doosre memory block mein data kharabi report hui

causes.en: EEPROM data block 2 corrupt.
causes.ur: EEPROM data block 2 corrupt hai

causes.en: Board data invalid after a service parameter change.
causes.ur: Service parameter change karne par board ka data invalid ho gaya

solutions.en: Restore default parameters and clear the alarm.
solutions.ur: Default parameters wapas set karein aur alarm clear karein.

solutions.en: Replace the indoor control board if the fault returns.
solutions.ur: Kharabi wapas aaye to indoor control board badal dein

notes.en: The bulletin prints this meaning as a second 73 row, but the Primairy H-LINK adapter mapping lists indoor EEPROM Data 2 as 74, which is why 74 is reported here.
notes.ur: Bulletin is meaning ko doosri 73 row ki tarah print karta hai, lekin Primairy H-LINK adapter mapping indoor EEPROM Data 2 ko 74 batati hai, isi liye yahan 74 report kiya gaya hai.

codes.blinkPattern: Two-digit code read from LEDs, 2 s pauses: red operating LED = 7 blinks, green defrost LED = 4 blinks

title.en: Indoor room air temperature sensor fault
title.ur: Indoor room air temperature sensor ki kharabi

meaning.en: The indoor room temperature sensor is defective or not connected.
meaning.ur: Indoor room temperature sensor kharab hai ya connect nahi

causes.en: Room air sensor defective or unplugged.
causes.ur: Room air sensor kharab hai ya nikal hua hai

causes.en: Circuit board input defective.
causes.ur: Circuit board ka input kharab hai

solutions.en: Check and replace the room sensor or re-seat its connector.
solutions.ur: Room sensor check kar ke badlein ya us ka connector mazboot karein

solutions.en: Replace the circuit board if the sensor tests good.
solutions.ur: Sensor theek nikle to circuit board badal dein

notes.en: Corroborated by the H-LINK mapping (indoor ambient temperature sensor fault, Primairy 81).
notes.ur: H-LINK mapping ise confirm karti hai (indoor ambient temperature sensor fault, Primairy 81).

codes.blinkPattern: Two-digit code read from LEDs, 2 s pauses: red operating LED = 8 blinks, green defrost LED = 1 blink

title.en: Indoor heat exchanger temperature sensor fault
title.ur: Indoor heat exchanger temperature sensor kharab

meaning.en: The indoor coil sensor is defective or not connected.
meaning.ur: Indoor coil ka sensor kharab hai ya connect nahi

causes.en: Heat exchanger sensor defective or its lead damaged.
causes.ur: Heat exchanger ka sensor kharab hai ya us ki lead tooti hui hai

causes.en: Circuit board input defective.
causes.ur: Circuit board ka input kharab hai

solutions.en: Check and replace the coil sensor or re-seat its connector.
solutions.ur: Coil sensor check kar ke badlein ya us ka connector mazboot karein

solutions.en: Replace the circuit board if the sensor tests good.
solutions.ur: Sensor theek nikle to circuit board badal dein

notes.en: Corroborated by the H-LINK mapping (evaporator middle temperature sensor fault, Primairy 83).
notes.ur: H-LINK mapping ise confirm karti hai (evaporator middle temperature sensor fault, Primairy 83).

codes.blinkPattern: Two-digit code read from LEDs, 2 s pauses: red operating LED = 8 blinks, green defrost LED = 3 blinks

title.ur: Wired remote controller ki communication kharabi

meaning.en: The main control board cannot talk to the wired remote controller.
meaning.ur: Main control board wired remote controller se baat nahi kar pa raha

causes.en: Connection to the wired remote is incorrect, loose or broken.
causes.ur: Wired remote ka connection ghalat, dheela ya toota hua hai

causes.en: Wired remote or control board defective.
causes.ur: Wired remote ya control board kharab hai

solutions.en: Check and re-terminate the remote connection.
solutions.ur: Remote ka connection check kar ke dobara terminate karein

solutions.en: Replace the wired remote or the control board after substitution testing.
solutions.ur: Substitution test karke wired remote ya control board badal dein

notes.en: The bulletin prints FE (254), so 254 is kept as an alias. Corroborated by the H-LINK mapping (communication between main control board and wiring remote controller, display on wiring remote controller).
notes.ur: Bulletin FE (254) print karta hai, is liye 254 alias ke tor par rakha gaya. H-LINK mapping ise confirm karti hai (communication between main control board and wiring remote controller, display on wiring remote controller).

meaning.en: The main control board cannot talk to the display board.
meaning.ur: Main control board display board se baat nahi kar pa raha

causes.en: Display board connection wrong, loose or missing.
causes.ur: Display board ka connection ghalat, dheela ya mojood hi nahi

causes.en: Display board or control board defective.
causes.ur: Display board ya control board kharab hai

solutions.en: Check the connection to the display board and re-seat it.
solutions.ur: Display board ka connection check kar ke wapas lagayein

solutions.en: Replace the display board or the control board as required.
solutions.ur: Zarurat ke mutabiq display board ya control board badal dein

notes.en: Corroborated by the H-LINK mapping (communication between main control board and display board, displays on display board).
notes.ur: Ye ise H-LINK mapping confirm karti hai (communication between main control board and display board, aur yeh display board par nazar aata hai).
